name: agents-tools-version
title: agents: version committer and staff tool state
head: dfc7196a9f78876e51933c6d7283022f05e3e527
notes: A 6-line commit (+6/-2 in committer/main.dang and staff/main.dang) whose bug lives outside the diff: it bumps the agent entries to withTools version 1 but leaves Committer's continuations binding at version 0. Ground truth from history: fixed by vito/agents#34 (416f96fbe2, merged 2026-10-16), and again as c6765e4 (committer: rebind tools at the agent's version) in this repository's history, so it is vetted real. Tests whether a reviewer reads the code the diff relies on, and stays quiet otherwise.

issues.summary: Committer's agent entry now binds `withTools(currentNode, except: plumbing, version: 1)`, but reset, rebaseAbort and the rebase stop/finish paths return a continuation that rebinds Committer with `llm.withTools(tools, except: plumbing)`, i.e. version 0. After any of those tools, the next tool reload sees the version change (0 -> 1) and resets Committer's state: saved workspaces and an in-progress rebase are lost ('resetting tool state: its withTools version changed'). Fixed by vito/agents#34 (committer: keep the tools version in continuations: a shared toolsVersion and a continueWith helper) and c6765e4, which pass the same version in all four continuations.

sound.summary: Staff is bound with withTools only in its agent entry; its other withTools calls bind different objects (peers, chiefLine), so bumping Staff's version needs no other change.

A withTools version bump discards saved tool state from an older version instead of failing to load it, which is the commit's stated purpose (reloading sessions saved before the address/collection refactors).
